description: Email copy as config, not literals in code. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by the sending service; a template rendering with an unknown placeholder fails loudly rather than sending half-written copy.

magic_link.subject: Your Sustentra sign-in link
magic_link.body:
Hi {name},

Here is your sign-in link for Sustentra:

{verify_url}

The link works once and expires in {ttl_minutes} minutes. If it expires, just request another one.

If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

- The Sustentra team

seed_form_received.subject: We have your company details
seed_form_received.body:
Hi {name},

Thanks - we have recorded the details for {legal_name}, covering {reporting_period_start} to {reporting_period_end}, across {site_count} site(s).

Next you will be guided through a short set of questions about each site. You can stop and come back at any time.

If anything above looks wrong, reply to this email and we will fix it.

- The Sustentra team
